title: AlphaFold - The Most Useful Thing AI Has Ever Done
summary: A Veritasium video on AlphaFold, DeepMind's protein structure prediction system, and the protein design work it enabled. It features interviews with John Jumper and with David Baker's protein design group and explains why predicting protein folding matters.
why: HN points to it as an accessible explainer of AlphaFold and as an example of narrow, specialized ML delivering real scientific breakthroughs.

quote.text: To learn more about AlphaFold and its importance, I would recommend the Veritasium video[0]
